name: mdld-parse
description: Write RDF knowledge graphs as plain Markdown. Parse to quads, generate back, merge documents. The human-friendly semantic web format.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.config.lib.js && cp -r docs/ dist/docs/ && cp -r server/ dist/server/ && cp -r examples/ dist/examples/ && cp -r grammar/ dist/grammar/  && cp -r ontologies/ dist/ontologies/ && cp -r spec/ dist/spec/ && cp -r README.md dist/README.md && cp -r docs.html dist/docs.html && cp -r demo/ dist/demo/ && cp -r src/ dist/src/
